p.i: Nec alba Sparsis saxa Sirenum ossibus.
Qua spe superba furitis, aut fiducia
Quas nunc egestas, mox egestatis malis
Cùm pretia vestri, aetate quamuis integra,
Nec compararit digna quae saltem foret
Iam iam senectius verticem tinget comis

page.notes: Printed text is in italic throughout. Line-initial "V" and "I" are printed capitals for u and i; rendered per the rule as u/v and i/j where vowels or consonants.
